rule: During the frozen educational phase, failures may repair the EXPERIMENT but may not expand Torin's cognitive implementation.
may_be_repaired: an exam that leaks an answer
a harness that bypasses the production ingress
a metric that cannot report failure
a database or process state that does not reset
may_not_be_repaired: Torin cannot parse a legitimate held-out construction
why: Repairing a cognitive capability mid-experiment destroys the distinction between 'Torin learned' and 'we upgraded Torin while teaching it'. A capability Torin cannot acquire through education IS the result.
why_refrozen: MAX_BODY_LITERALS raised 12 -> 16. It bounds a 2**n subset enumeration, not what a real rule may look like, and at 12 a THIRD demonstration could push the LGG to 14 literals and return INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE -- more evidence made induction fail. Still before any Stage 2 instruction.

change.reverted: a greedy LGG reduction was implemented first and REVERTED: it picks one minimal body and discards the competing ones, so underdetermined demonstrations returned RULE_LEARNED instead of MULTIPLE_HYPOTHESES. It manufactured certainty to fit under a performance bound; the version-space tests caught it.

verified_model_free.list operator learned: MEAN_OF -> [MEAN(?X1,?X0), MEAN_OF(?X1)] => VALUE(?X0), choosing MEAN over SUM/LENGTH/MAXIMUM/EXCEEDING
verified_model_free.composition on an UNSEEN list: [5,15,25,35] -> PLAN_FOUND: MEAN_OF(lx) -> COUNT_EXCEEDING(lx), the second requiring the threshold the first produces
